unmapped_findings: Solution-treated reference hardness for the Ni-free Fe-15Mn-10Al-0.8C alloy (parent state of this 500 °C sample): γ = 4 GPa and α = 3 GPa (Table 2; b0034).
Mn content of κ-carbide in the Ni-free alloy annealed at 500 °C: ≈18.4 wt.% Mn in the α + κ composite and 20.4 wt.% Mn in the γ + κ composite (Fig. 4f, Fig. 4h; b0029).
At low annealing temperatures (500–700 °C) this Ni-free alloy exhibited low ductility, with elongation ≈10% (b0014).
Annealing holding time for the 500 °C treatment is not explicitly reported in the text (b0017).

The Ni-free alloy is denoted Fe-15Mn-10Al-0.8C throughout the abstract/introduction/methods/conclusions but is labelled Fe-15Mn-10Al-0.5C in Tables 1 and 2, an apparent typographical inconsistency (0.5 vs 0.8 C).
